note: Identifiers only. Remake only pots, crates and flying pots: placed base actors whose hash no other catalog row holds, that use the drop and saved row of the pot slice (base actor, no Presence flag, no boss door resupply table, a supply row of reset type 88, 280 for flying pots, an own drop or own table of one shipped pickup or no own drop at all). Names are made up for this tool and never change, Archipelago reads them. The adult and the child copy of a spot are two rows. vanilla is the own drop, the item of the own table, else Rupee (1). region is the logic region the spot is added to. Rows 1 to 19 (revision 1) took the one region of every known check in the same dungeon room. Rows of revision 2 collect every region the data offers for the spot (the regions of the known checks with the same DefaultDungeonRoomIndex, the OoTR candidates of the remake research, the OoTR guess of the tracker table, else the known checks within 20 units in the same layer) and take the HARDER one, the region the vanilla playthrough reaches last at the age of the spot. basis says which. rule is the baseline: the age of the layer, can_break_crate for a crate, nothing else, unless every OoTR candidate agrees on one region and rule. These spots hold any item, key items included. A region that is too easy can lock a seed, fix it in data/logic/spot_overrides.json.
